plan: Drive: from District of Kitimat, about 33 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate).
Park: 54.17714, -128.68721, pull off on Wedeene FSR (gravel road). Map links below.

Hunt: ducks, Jan, Oct, Nov, Dec (season rows). Set up on the shore with the wind at your back: ducks land into the wind (Tip). Shoot only birds you can retrieve.
Use: 12 gauge, steel 2 to 4 (non toxic shot only), modified or improved cylinder rated for steel, plugged to 3 shells (regs).

Legal: MU (Management Unit) 6-11, Region 6. Season: ducks Oct 1 to Nov 30, 8 a day, 24 in possession and more rows (federal Migratory Birds Regulations, 99%). 1 legal flag below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.

R6E-duck-drive-0002.recDirections: From the Kitimat Service Centre head north along Enterprise Avenue until you reach the Wedeene Mainline Forestry Road. Continue north along the mainline for approximately 14.5 km.
